Introduction

HANA is a four-member South Korean girl group under artcompany SOUL. Originally eight, they made their debut on January 8, 2023 with the single "BLA:ZE".

On January 3, 2024, HANA's official Instagram page posted a photo of the members with a caption stating that, after careful consideration and discussion with them, the group’s activities had officially ended. However, on September 3, 2025, the group’s Instagram account posted a photo of a logo with the caption "coming soon".
